issues.description: Multiple React hydration errors: 'Text content does not match server-rendered HTML' and 'Invalid or unexpected token'. The entire root switches to client rendering due to hydration failure.
issues.root_cause: Likely caused by dynamic values (e.g. currency formatting with locale-specific number separators, or template literals with special characters like em-dash '—') rendering differently on server vs client. The '$500 — $2,000' text with em-dash or locale-dependent formatting is a common hydration mismatch source. Also 'Invalid or unexpected token' suggests a syntax error in the source file.

issues.description: Step indicator shows 'STEP 3 OF 4' but the URL is /design/step-5. The step counter is wrong — it should reflect step 5 (e.g. 'STEP 5 OF 5' or similar).
issues.root_cause: The step-5 page.tsx hardcodes or incorrectly computes the step number, showing '3 of 4' instead of the correct value for step 5.

issues.description: Only 2 budget tier cards are visible (Essential partially and one more). Expected behavior is 4-5 cards (Essential, Elevated, Refined, Prestige, Signature). Cards are in a carousel/swipe layout which hides other options and may not meet the spec of showing all tiers.
issues.root_cause: The cards are rendered in a horizontal scroll/swipe container showing only 1 card at a time. Either the other tier cards are missing from the data array, or the layout needs adjustment to show all cards.

fixes.reason: Fix incorrect step counter — the URL is /design/step-5 so the step indicator must reflect step 5.

If the file uses a smart/curly quote instead of straight quote for the directive, it causes 'Invalid or unexpected token' syntax error and hydration failure. Ensure the use client directive uses straight single quotes.
